prep.summary:
Invoice/billing functionality is complete, including rendering, pagination, continuation, rollback-safe finalization, billing sessions, void/cancel behavior, posted-only summaries, credits/refunds, payment-failure logging, and scheduler DST handling. Currency uses `ROUND_HALF_UP`; the `999999999999.995` boundary test exists, though focused tests and lint should be rerun before final closure.

Billing-worker memory growth was addressed. Failed usage-event persistence is retained for retry, incoming batches are copied before extending pending state, and unused `_last_batch` state was removed. A regression confirms completed events do not leak into later batches. Worker tests pass (41), a 5,000-batch reproduction showed 7.3 MiB peak, 2.1 MiB retained, and zero pending events. `self.completed_batches` still stores full payload dictionaries, including customer metadata, and remains the main memory consideration. The latest full suite passed: 118 tests, 7 skipped.

CLI billing-filter cleanup is now validated. Shared invoice-date and currency arguments were consolidated via `_add_billing_filters(parser)`. The currency argument explicitly sets `dest="currency"`, restoring typed parsed values. CLI tests pass (15), command tests pass (22), and a manual temporary-fixture invoice-list query successfully filtered open USD invoices and honored the limit. A command test was updated to use `args.currency` instead of the obsolete nested `args.filters["currency"]`.

Next: run lint/focused/full tests after the CLI refactor, review remaining relevant references, and monitor `completed_batches` if further memory optimization is needed. Terraform deployment succeeded; VPC peering `pcx-0a9b8c7d6e5f40312` still needs acceptance.
